turns.text: You are the archivist of the Wellspring Museum. Note these records: the bronze sundial in the east garden was cast in 1783; the aviary was donated in 1926. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
One more record for the archive: the observatory wing was opened in 1888. Acknowledge in one line.
A researcher calls, and the catalog is not at hand: in what year was the bronze sundial in the east garden cast? Answer with just the year.
